subject.title: fix(codex): resolve dynamic tool hard timeout from timeoutSeconds when timeoutMs is absent

question: Should maintainers continue this PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98864, or consolidate on a sibling candidate with stronger current-head proof?
rationale: The remaining blocker is a real merge-readiness choice across overlapping PRs plus stale proof, not a product feature decision that automation can settle safely.

options.title: Repair and prove this PR
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only if the author updates the PR body with current-head runtime proof for the sessions_send-shaped timeout case and maintainers accept the 10s headroom/conversion shape.

options.title: Consolidate on stronger sibling
options.body: Use the sibling candidate with shared conversion/headroom and stronger runtime proof as the canonical landing path, then close duplicate candidates after that fix is safe or merged.

options.title: Pause all candidates
options.body: Leave the competing PRs open until a Codex app-server owner chooses the permanent conversion and watchdog grace policy.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on stronger sibling
recommendation.body: Use the sibling candidate with shared conversion/headroom and stronger runtime proof as the canonical landing path, then close duplicate candidates after that fix is safe or merged.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Codex app-server work and PR 98704 history make this the best available owner signal for choosing the canonical landing path.
